rewrite.rewritten_title: TunerCat's OBD2 Tuner Now Available for Vortec and LS1 Trucks, Camaros, and Corvettes
rewrite.summary: The TunerCat OBD2 tuner is now available for a range of trucks and cars including Vortec and LS1 trucks, as well as Camaros and Corvettes. The cost is $379.
rewrite.rewritten_article_markdown:
The TunerCat OBD2 tuner is now available for a range of trucks and cars including Vortec and LS1 trucks, as well as Camaros and Corvettes. The cost is $379.

### Available Vehicles
- **Trucks:** 1996 - 1997 Vortec Trucks (4.3L, 5.0L, 5.7L, 7.4L), 1998 - 2000 Vortec Trucks (4.3L, 5.0L, 5.7L, 7.4L), 1999 - 2000 LS1 Trucks (4.8L, 5.3L, 6.0L, 8.1L), 2001 - 2002 LS1 Trucks (4.8L, 5.3L, 6.0L, 8.1L), 2003 - 2005 LS1 Trucks (4.8L, 5.3L, 6.0L, 8.1L)
- **Cars:** 1996 - 1997 Camaro/Firebird/Corvette LT1, 1999 - 2001 Camaro/Firebird/Corvette LS1, 2002 - 2003 Camaro/Firebird/Corvette LS1, 2004 Corvette/GTO

### What's Included in the Package
- OBDII Tuner Program on CD
- OBDII/RS232 Interface
- OBDII Cable
- RS232 Cable
- Your choice of one Vehicle Definition File

post_rewrites.rewritten_content:
I recently received an email from TunerCat announcing that their new OBD2 tuner is now available for the following vehicles:

**Trucks:**
- 1996-1997 Vortec Trucks (4.3L, 5.0L, 5.7L, 7.4L)
- 1998-2000 Vortec Trucks (4.3L, 5.0L, 5.7L, 7.4L)
- 1999-2000 LS1 Trucks (4.8L, 5.3L, 6.0L, 8.1L)
- 2001-2002 LS1 Trucks (4.8L, 5.3L, 6.0L, 8.1L)
- 2003-2005 LS1 Trucks (4.8L, 5.3L, 6.0L, 8.1L)

**Cars:**
- 1996-1997 Camaro/Firebird/Corvette LT1
- 1999-2001 Camaro/Firebird/Corvette LS1
- 2002-2003 Camaro/Firebird/Corvette LS1
- 2004 Corvette/GTO

The package includes an OBDII tuner program on CD, OBDII and RS232 interfaces, and an OBDII cable with a choice of one Vehicle Definition File.

Perhaps we should consider a group purchase. Also, check out this link for more details: [http://www.ls1tech.com/forums/showth...light=TunerCat](http://www.ls1tech.com/forums/showth...light=TunerCat)

Here is what the tuner can edit: [http://james.jaguar.net/kctrading/Cal_Parameters.pdf](http://james.jaguar.net/kctrading/Cal_Parameters.pdf)

Now, I just need to secure a low-cost laptop!

The program enables full programming modifications to the stock computer, allowing changes to fueling, spark timing, and shift points. I've been programming TBI trucks for some time, but those use a removable EPROM where you "burn" the file. OBD2 trucks have flash-programmable chips that remain in place. Until now, no programs could edit Vortec truck PCM settings, and only a few shops nationwide offered reprogramming services.
I believe I would accidentally damage something while attempting to figure this out.

TC recently informed me that the OBDII Tuner is now available for certain vehicles with more upcoming models scheduled for early release this year. The currently supported vehicle models include:

- OBD2_07: 1996-1997 Vortec Trucks (4.3L, 5.7L, 7.4L)
- OBD2_06: 1998-2000 Vortec Trucks (4.3L, 5.7L, 7.4L)
- OBD2_02: 1999-2000 LS1 Trucks (4.8L, 5.3L, 6.0L)
- OBD2_01: 1999-2001 Camaro/Firebird/Corvette LS1
- OBD2_03: 2001-2002 LS1 Trucks (4.8L, 5.3L, 6.0L)
- OBD2_04: 2003-2004 LS1 Trucks (4.8L, 5.3L, 6.0L)
- OBD2_08: 1996-1997 Camaro/Firebird/Corvette LT1
- OBD2_09: 1997-1998 Camaro/Firebird/Corvette LS1
- OBD2_05: 2002-2003 Camaro/Firebird/Corvette LS1
- OBD2_10: 2004 Corvette

This will provide tuning capabilities for GEN1 Vortec (4.3/5.0/5.7/7.4L) vehicles. More details are still pending.
